services.name: Ghost Tours
services.desc: Get your tickets now to explore and investigate the paranormal in one of Montana’s most haunted locations, the Old Montana Prison. The doors to the Old Montana Prison Visitor Center will open at 8:00 pm, where your guide will meet you to get you checked in and ready with equipment for the night. You can also bring your own equipment if you choose to do so. You will be able to investigate the grounds and buildings of the prison until 2:00 am when the investigation concludes. You will be taken to areas of the prison that are not open to the public, like the Death Tower and the upper tiers of the Cell House. Snacks and beverages will also be provided throughout the night. blurb: “God created man, but the Colt made him equal” is the title on one exhibit case in Frontier Montana Museum. This is the largest collection of handguns, spurs, chaps, and all the cowboy collectibles between Cody and Calgary.
